# Sentinel 0.5.0
Released on 06/11/2026.
Sentinel now gathers the context around a pull request or merge request, groups related work into Topics, and has a new Settings window.
## New
- **Context.** A pull request's Context tab gathers what relates to it from Slack, Jira, Bitrise, Confluence and your Claude Code sessions into a summary that links every source. Sentinel reads them through your own Claude Code's MCP servers, read-only. Turn it on in Settings → Context; Sentinel keeps it current and shows what changed since you last looked. - **Topics.** Group pull requests, merge requests and links about one subject. Sentinel suggests a Topic when items share a ticket, a thread or a build. Add an item with ⌥⌘T, and follow a Topic to hear when it changes. - **AI spending.** Settings → AI → Usage and budget shows what AI runs cost by day, module and model. Set a daily or monthly budget: Sentinel warns at 80% and pauses automatic runs when you reach it. The runs you start yourself keep working. - **Follow any repository.** Paste the URL of a repository you are not a member of, such as a public project, in Add Repository. Sentinel never publishes there by itself. - **Undo and Redo** (⌘Z, ⇧⌘Z) for your actions in Sentinel, such as Start Review, Mark Done or accepting a finding. Comments on GitHub or GitLab are not undone. - **Back and forward** between the places you visited, with ⌘[ and ⌘] or the arrows in the toolbar.
## Improved
- Settings is rebuilt like System Settings, with search and a page for each account, repository and source. - Search finds a pull request or merge request by its number: 57, !57 or #57. - The repository bar shows when its list was last updated. - Sentinel no longer checks the context of closed or merged items.

# Sentinel 0.4.0
Released on 19/10/2026.
One chat per pull request or merge request, a window of its own for each item, and a terminal that runs Claude Code on Sentinel's copy of the code.
## New
- **Open in New Window** (⌘O) gives an item a window of its own, with Details, Chat, Sessions and Terminal. It comes back at the next launch. - **One chat per item** about the whole pull request or merge request, its sessions and its findings. Type @ to ask about a session or a finding. Replies appear as they are written, and Stop (⌘.) keeps what arrived. - **Turn answers into work**: a new draft, a revised finding, a reply on a thread or the text of an approval. What the AI proposes arrives as a card you add, edit or discard, and a published comment changes only after Update Comment. - **Terminal tab** that runs Claude Code, or a command you choose, on Sentinel's copy of the item, never in your clone. - **Right bar beside or over the detail** (⌃⌥⌘0).
## Improved
- Copy a message as Markdown or plain text, quote it, or export the conversation. ⇧⌘C copies the last answer. - ⌘R refreshes the item in front, ⇧⌘R refreshes everything, and ⌥⌘1 to ⌥⌘4 pick the right bar's tabs. - Settings → AI Backend → Terminal chooses the terminal app sessions open in.

# Sentinel 0.3.0
Released on 12/10/2026.
A new design for the whole app, in dark and light, with a new sidebar, list and item detail.
## New
- **A new look** in dark and light. Settings → General → Appearance follows the system or keeps one. - **Sidebar** with one row per repository, grouped by connection, that collapses to a compact rail (⌃⌥⌘S). - **Item header** with three cards: your review, the provider's checks and the AI review, including why an AI review failed. - **The Review tab** shows the whole conversation in order: comments, threads, commits and pipelines, with the AI's findings as drafts in place. - **Approve or request changes** from Sentinel, with Draft with AI for the text (request changes needs GitLab 18.9 or later). Reply on, resolve and unresolve any thread. - **Chat** about a whole pull request or merge request: what to test, the riskiest change, a summary. - **Focus the next AI review** on what matters to you, such as "check the token storage". - **More filters**: review requested from me, assigned to me, several authors or labels, GitLab approvals left, and the severity of open findings, with quick chips for the common ones. - **Notifications** when CI fails or passes again on a queued item, when the review decision changes, or when merge conflicts appear.
## Improved
- Compact or Regular list density, and columns that adapt to the window. - Add Repository finds a repository by any part of its path. - Continue a completed AI session by hand in Terminal.
## Fixed
- Cancel did not always stop a running AI review. - A long line of code in a comment could freeze the item detail.
